node.title: Re: multiple URL web scraping
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Lisa1993],

It sounds like you're fairly new to Perl, so I'd suggest you have a look at [doc://perlintro] which goes over many of the basics. In this case a loop, something like foreach my $url (@urls) { ... } might be appropriate for you.

It also covers reading from files, have a look at the [doc://perlintro#Files-and-I/O] section, which shows you how to use [doc://open], [doc://perlsyn#Loop-Control|while] and [doc://close]. A tip, since that section doesn't mention it, have a look at [doc://chomp] too.

As for your second question, yes, [doc://sleep], [doc://int], and [doc://rand] are Perl built-in functions, so you can always use them anywhere.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
